instruction:
You are an ITS/VMS engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-13 message legibility and power package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External MUTCD, owner message policy, NTCIP, and power tools shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-13-LH-05`
- VMS schedule: `VMS-13-SCHED-05`
- Message library: `MSG-13-LIB-05`
- Road speed and geometry: `ROAD-13-SPEED-05`
- Network topology: `NET-13-TOPO-05`
- Power schedule: `PWR-13-SCHED-05`
- VMS operations memo: `MEMO-13-VMS-05`

All checks use the same sign identity, message library, viewing-speed case, network path, and power schedule.

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Letter height | {{ letter_height_mm }} mm |
| Legibility factor | {{ legibility_factor_m_per_mm }} m/mm |
| Available viewing distance | {{ available_viewing_distance_m }} m |
| Road speed | {{ road_speed_kmh }} km/h |
| Required read time | {{ required_read_time_s }} s |
| Display/controller/modem power | {{ display_power_w }} W / {{ controller_power_w }} W / {{ modem_power_w }} W |
| Circuit capacity | {{ circuit_capacity_w }} W |
| VMS/controller network load | {{ vms_network_mbps }} Mbps / {{ controller_network_mbps }} Mbps |
| Network capacity | {{ network_capacity_mbps }} Mbps |
| Compliant message rows | {{ compliant_message_count }} of {{ required_message_count }} |

## Output Format

Write a compact VMS operations memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "required_legibility_distance_m": <numeric_value>,
  "legibility_distance_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "available_read_time_s": <numeric_value>,
  "read_time_margin_s": <numeric_value>,
  "vms_power_load_w": <numeric_value>,
  "power_headroom_w": <numeric_value>,
  "network_load_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "network_headroom_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "message_policy_match_fraction": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-13 VMS message legibility and power template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one task-owned VMS source pack and expected outputs.

[meta]
name = "vms-message-legibility-power-package"
description = "SSC-13 VMS message legibility, read-time, network, and power checks"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound VMS operations metrics from a deterministic SSC-13 task-owned source pack. The template combines a VMS schedule, message library, road speed/geometry table, network topology, and power schedule."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "vms-operations"
standards = ["MUTCD message workflow", "VMS legibility review", "NTCIP workflow", "power schedule review"]
tags = ["electrical", "its", "vms", "message", "legibility", "power", "network", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.letter_height_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "VMS-13-SCHED-05 display letter height"
min = 320.0
max = 320.0

[params.legibility_factor_m_per_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "m/mm"
description = "MSG-13-LIB-05 legibility distance factor"
min = 0.6
max = 0.6

[params.available_viewing_distance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "ROAD-13-SPEED-05 available VMS viewing distance"
min = 225.0
max = 225.0

[params.road_speed_kmh]
type = "float"
unit = "km/h"
description = "ROAD-13-SPEED-05 road speed"
min = 80.0
max = 80.0

[params.required_read_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "MSG-13-LIB-05 required read time"
min = 6.5
max = 6.5

[params.display_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "PWR-13-SCHED-05 VMS display power"
min = 650.0
max = 650.0

[params.controller_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "PWR-13-SCHED-05 VMS controller power"
min = 85.0
max = 85.0

[params.modem_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "PWR-13-SCHED-05 VMS modem power"
min = 25.0
max = 25.0

[params.circuit_capacity_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "PWR-13-SCHED-05 circuit capacity"
min = 1200.0
max = 1200.0

[params.vms_network_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "NET-13-TOPO-05 VMS network load"
min = 2.8
max = 2.8

[params.controller_network_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "NET-13-TOPO-05 controller network load"
min = 0.4
max = 0.4

[params.network_capacity_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "NET-13-TOPO-05 network capacity"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[params.compliant_message_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MSG-13-LIB-05 compliant message rows"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.required_message_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MSG-13-LIB-05 required message rows"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[outputs.required_legibility_distance_m]
description = "Required legibility distance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.legibility_distance_margin_m]
description = "Available viewing distance minus required distance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.available_read_time_s]
description = "Available read time at road speed"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.read_time_margin_s]
description = "Available read time minus required read time"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.vms_power_load_w]
description = "VMS display/controller/modem power load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.power_headroom_w]
description = "Circuit capacity minus VMS load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.network_load_mbps]
description = "VMS network load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.network_headroom_mbps]
description = "Network capacity minus VMS network load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.message_policy_match_fraction]
description = "Compliant message rows divided by required rows"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when VMS legibility, read-time, network, and power checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001

[archetypes.ssc13_vms_message_case]
description = "VMS message legibility and power case"
site_contexts = ["ssc13-vms-message"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-13 VMS package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc13_vms_message_case"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-13 VMS package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc13_vms_message_case"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-13 VMS package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc13_vms_message_case"]
